caption: Did Jesus have to arrive before Judah disappeared? Genesis speaks about royal rule, not the tribe losing its identity. The supposed deadline is not in the text.

slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: A deadline before Judah disappeared? The claim says God’s promised ruler had to arrive before Judah lost its identity. Genesis actually talks about Judah keeping a sceptre and ruler’s staff.
slides.body: The claim says God’s promised ruler had to arrive before Judah lost its identity. Genesis actually talks about Judah keeping a sceptre and ruler’s staff.
slides.heading: A deadline before Judah disappeared?

slides.alt_text: The BSB text of Gen 49:10: The scepter will not depart from Judah, nor the staff from between his feet, until Shiloh comes and the allegiance of the nations is his.
slides.body: The scepter will not depart from Judah, nor the staff from between his feet, until Shiloh comes and the allegiance of the nations is his.
slides.heading: Gen 49:10

slides.alt_text: The claimed New Testament fulfilment in Jn 11:47–52, BSB: The chief priests and Pharisees convened the Sanhedrin … ‘The Romans will come and take away both our place and our nation.’
slides.body: The chief priests and Pharisees convened the Sanhedrin … ‘The Romans will come and take away both our place and our nation.’
slides.heading: Claimed fulfilment · Jn 11:47–52

slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: Why Christians connect them If the verse promises a ruler from Judah, Jesus arrives while Jewish leaders and institutions still exist. That can look like the promise reaching its goal in time.
slides.body: If the verse promises a ruler from Judah, Jesus arrives while Jewish leaders and institutions still exist. That can look like the promise reaching its goal in time.
slides.heading: Why Christians connect them

slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: But rule is not identity Losing political power is not the same as a tribe ceasing to exist. Genesis gives no deadline based on tribal identity, and the passage in John does not add one.
slides.body: Losing political power is not the same as a tribe ceasing to exist. Genesis gives no deadline based on tribal identity, and the passage in John does not add one.
slides.heading: But rule is not identity

title: Did the Messiah have to come before Judah lost its identity?
